title: Hylo router — caller-supplied-account substitution on `route` (0-declared-account CPI proxy)
closed_reasons: route is a CPI proxy with a hard-coded target program (substituting the program account => MissingAccount)

every forwarded account is re-validated by the Hylo exchange: 2006 ConstraintSeeds, 2003 ConstraintRaw, 2003 ConstraintRaw, 2006 ConstraintSeeds, 2014 ConstraintTokenMint, 2015 ConstraintTokenOwner, 3010 AccountNotSigner, 3012 AccountNotInitialized
router rejects unsupported/ mismatched pairs itself: 6000 UnsupportedPair
router signs nothing and holds nothing: EXO_REGISTRY and EVENT_AUTH PDAs do not exist; 0 token accounts owned by the router program or its PDAs
router PDAs are router::ID PDAs and can never satisfy exchange::ID PDA constraints
key_facts: live instruction is route v1 (disc e517cb977ae3ad2a); route_v2's exo_registry PDA F7BfTbic9AyaNKT7e4eoSbgZC7yxJvutA6S4VzosASg9 does not exist
real mainnet route CPI replayed as positive control => SUCCESS; 12 substitutions all rejected
router ELF 240376 B sha256 25f88987c8223775fd4e0fd8e7a2a3bf85503f7b5b3112fe801d30cfac80d415, upgrade authority GzyhwK4y7EKPEevAMc2TEpgi1Y3znwj14FUzkHmCMiNP, deployed slot 439863765
exchange custody measured $58,538,018.64 (JITOSOL vault $30.20M, earn-pool hyUSD $20.56M, cbBTC $3.36M, hySOL $2.39M, HYPE $2.04M) — reachable only via the exchange program
caveats: router source is not public; account-resolution inferred from the project's published IDL + live behaviour (the empirical result does not depend on it)
sigVerify:false simulation; H13 (no user signer => AccountNotSigner) shows the exchange really requires the user's signature
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the Hylo router; `route` is a hard-coded-target CPI proxy whose accounts are re-validated by the exchange and which signs nothing/holds nothing
